## Company Overview
AquaMate Inc. is a leading manufacturer of custom pool liners based in Collingwood, Ontario, Canada. We specialize in premium quality vinyl pool liners for any pool shape or size.

- Company: AquaMate Inc.
- Industry: Pool Liner Manufacturing
- Location: Collingwood, Ontario, Canada

## Products and Services
1. Custom Pool Liners

   - Multiple pattern and color options

2. Liner Collections
   - AquaFinish™ - Premium finish liners
   - AquaSculpt™ - Textured and patterned designs
   - AquaShift™ - Color-changing effects
   - AquaShimmer™ - Metallic and shimmer finishes

3. Services

## Frequently Asked Questions
1. Do you ship internationally? Yes, we ship across North America.
2. What warranty do you offer? We provide comprehensive warranty coverage on all our products.
3. Can you make custom shapes? Yes, we specialize in custom pool liner fabrication for any shape or size.
4. How long does manufacturing take? Typical lead time is 2-3 weeks depending on the season.
